answer: When k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise-correlated evidence drives aggregate penalties to O(k²), rather than letting each Sybil absorb only an independent linear cost. Bonded escrow makes collateral slashable, while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the swarm; asymmetric depreciation further limits recovery. Thus identities named river, atlas, or ember cannot cheaply diversify one operator’s risk: coordination magnifies the cost of proven misconduct.
